newsitem.title: INDIA: India SBI down ahead of 1996/97 results.
newsitem.headline: India SBI down ahead of 1996/97 results.

text.p: Shares of India's largest commercial bank State Bank of India dropped 2.25 rupees to 335.75 at the Bombay Stock Exchange on Thursday ahead of its 1996/97 earnings announcement, traders said.

The bank is expected to report a net profit in the region of about 14.0 billion to 15.0 billion rupees for the year to March 31, 1997, up sharply from 8.32 billion rupees achieved the previous year, dealers said.
But traders said there was a lot of hype about SBI's results and it could disappoint markets.
